name: Quantum Physics
overview: Scripture reveals that the universe, including the invisible and mysterious realms that quantum physics seeks to understand, is the intentional creation of God, who in the beginning formed the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1). The Bible affirms God's sovereign power in sustaining the cosmos, describing how He hangs the earth upon nothing (Job 26:7) and laid its foundations by His hands (Psalms 102:25). The wonders of light and darkness, which are fundamental to the study of quantum phenomena, are acknowledged as part of God's design (Job 38:19), and the heavens themselves declare His glory and handiwork (Psalms 19:1). This affirms that all physical realities, no matter how complex or unseen, are under the authority and creative wisdom of the LORD (Proverbs 8:22).
